POST https://sdmdataaccess.sc.egov.usda.gov/Tabular/post.rest BODY {"service":"query","request":"query","query":"
    SELECT TOP 1
      mu.mukey,
      mu.muname,
      c.compname,
      c.comppct_r,
      c.drainagecl,
      c.hydgrp,
      c.slope_r
    FROM SDA_Get_Mukey_from_intersection_with_WktWgs84('POINT(-117.4 47.6)') AS spatial
    INNER JOIN mapunit mu ON mu.mukey = spatial.mukey
    INNER JOIN component c ON c.mukey = mu.mukey
    ORDER BY c.comppct_r DESC
  ","format":"JSON+COLUMNNAME"}
